items.title: Lennar Cuts Deliveries Target Again on Rate Pressure, Housing Market Conditions
items.summary: The homebuilding company said it expects full-year home deliveries of between 80,000 and 81,000 homes. That is down from its previous guidance for 82,000 to 83,000 deliveries, and below the 82,300 analysts polled by FactSet were expecting.

items.title: FactSet (FDS) Stock May Be 36% Undervalued On Returns
items.summary: FactSet Research Systems has seen its stock slide over the past few years, which naturally puts a spotlight on whether the current share price lines up with the returns it earns on the capital it invests. For anyone tracking data and analytics providers, the key puzzle now is how that track record of reinvesting in the business stacks up against what the market is asking you to pay today.
